title: Anounce Mod
description: Anounce Mod is a lightweight, server-side announcement system designed for simplicity, multilingual support, and full JSON configurability.
body:

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/anounce-mod?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/project/anounce-mod)
### Yapımcı
RBG


✨ Features
- 🧾 Simple Commands
- /anounce add <name> <interval> <text> – Add a timed message
- /anounce remove <name> – Remove a message
- JSO-based language files
- Easily extendable to any language (English, Turkish, etc.)
- ⏱️ Interval-Based Broadcasting
- Each message has its own timer
- Ideal for server tips, rules, or event reminders
